newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Rossiisky Kredit gets Spain import support.
newsitem.headline: Russian Rossiisky Kredit gets Spain import support.

text.p: Russia's Rossiisky Kredit bank has been accredited by Spain's national export insurance agency, which will insure 85 percent of the bank's liabilities for imports of Spanish goods to Russia, the bank said on Monday.

Russian importers will be able to extend payment periods on Spanish goods for a year or more because of the accreditation by Compania Espagnola de Seguros de Credito a la Exportacion, SA (CESCE), KB Rossiisky Kredit said in a statement.
The bank is in talks for similar agreements with British, Canadian, French and Finnish insurance agencies, it said.

Rossiisky Kredit has export insurance agreements with Germany's Hermes Kreditversicherungs-AG, Denmark's Eksportkreditfonden, EKF, Belgium's Office National de Ducroire, Austria's Oesterreichische Kontrollbank AG, Hungary's Magyar Exporthitel Biztosito Rt and Japan's MITI.
